text: Fresh air shall be provided at not less than 10 l/s per person for occupied rooms (7 l/s per person plus 0.7 l/s per m2 as ASHRAE 62.1 minimum) and enough to maintain the pressurisation of section 7; toilets and kitchens shall be exhausted at not less than 10 air changes per hour or 25 l/s per cubicle.
